name: private-board-worker
description: Google 로그인 뒤에만 보이는 Cloudflare Workers + D1 공용 게시판 및 개인 작업 보드

scripts.check: npm run security:check && npm run build:client && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.dev: npm run build:client && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build:client && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run check && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrations:list:local: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrations:list:remote: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
